findings.title: Direct Retailer vs. Redirect Role
findings.summary: It is unclear whether SmartRail will act as a direct retailer for all train tickets or redirect users to individual operator sites.
findings.unresolved_question: Will SmartRail act as a direct retailer for all train tickets, or will it redirect to individual operator sites for final purchase?
findings.rationale: Represents an unmerged business model ambiguity regarding ticketing functionality.

findings.title: Data Security and Privacy Protocols
findings.summary: Protocols must be defined for data security and privacy when storing passenger payment details and personal information.
findings.unresolved_question: What protocols will be in place for data security and privacy when storing payment details and personal information?
findings.rationale: Standalone security compliance discovery that requires explicit definition.

findings.title: Day of Travel Proactive Notifications and Disruption Updates
findings.summary: Send push notifications for significant delays, cancellations, platform changes, live train tracking updates, and disruption explanations.
findings.unresolved_question: What threshold constitutes a significant delay for a push notification and what level of detail will be provided in disruption explanations?
findings.rationale: Both findings deal with proactive passenger notifications regarding live train status and disruptions.

findings.title: Signal Loss and Device Failure
findings.summary: Passengers facing phone battery failure, missing tickets, or signal loss at the station when trying to present mobile tickets.
findings.unresolved_question: Will SmartRail have an offline mode for displaying mobile tickets in case of signal loss at the station?
findings.rationale: Unique failure scenario concerning offline access and device troubles.

findings.title: Station Navigation, Maps, and Facility Status
findings.summary: Provide interactive GPS-enabled station maps with facilities, accessible routes, coach stopping positions, and real-time out-of-order alerts for lifts, escalators, and accessible toilets.
findings.unresolved_question: What is the accuracy level of coach stopping position predictions and how will real-time lift status be consistently reported from all stations?
findings.rationale: Both items relate to station-level passenger navigation and facility status features.

findings.title: Discreet Issue Reporting on Board
findings.summary: A discreet feature allowing passengers to report non-emergency issues like heating problems or anti-social behavior directly to on-board staff.
findings.unresolved_question: What is the service level agreement for responses to issues reported via the app?
findings.rationale: Distinct extension capability for passenger-to-staff communication.

findings.title: Missed Connections and Connection Risks
findings.summary: Delays on initial trains putting connections at risk or causing missed connections without clear alternative guidance or protected status.
findings.unresolved_question: Will SmartRail clearly indicate if a connection is protected and what level of automatic re-booking will be facilitated?
findings.rationale: Specific failure scenario focusing on journey continuation and re-booking risks.

findings.title: Centralized Compensation and Support Services
findings.summary: Centralized and simplified processes for claiming Delay Repay, auto-populating journey details, and consolidated lost property searches.
findings.unresolved_question: Will SmartRail directly manage compensation claims or redirect to operators, and will the lost property portal require real-time updates from all operators?
findings.rationale: Both findings address post-journey administrative services and support platforms.

findings.title: Assumed Initial Business Problem
findings.summary: The railway currently suffers from inefficient and siloed incident management processes, leading to delayed responses, poor real-time communication with passengers, increased operational costs, and diminished customer satisfaction during disruptions.
findings.unresolved_question: What is the official baseline business problem description for SmartRail?
findings.rationale: Foundational product assumption that sets the baseline rationale for the system.

findings.title: Core Incident Management and Operational Capabilities
findings.summary: Authorized personnel can log incidents with details, track their lifecycle from reported to resolved, automatically alert operational teams, allocate basic resources, and view operational dashboards.
findings.unresolved_question: What are the precise triggers, recipients, and escalation paths for different incident types and severities?
findings.rationale: Cohesive set of core operational capabilities requested by the product owner for managing incidents.

findings.title: Basic Passenger Information Dissemination (Operational View)
findings.summary: Broadcast standardised, accurate delay and cancellation messages to passengers via multiple channels like station displays, app notifications, and website updates.
findings.unresolved_question: What specific channels are included and what level of detail is provided?
findings.rationale: Defines the operational perspective of passenger communications.

findings.title: Additional Operational Actors and Governance Processes
findings.summary: Identification of additional essential actors (train drivers, station staff, emergency services, etc.) and vital governance processes (emergency response, training, system integrations).
findings.rationale: Both findings highlight structural gaps regarding operational stakeholders and institutional processes.
